items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to instruct the people to sanctify themselves and wash their clothes

items.quote: the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai
items.claim: The LORD will descend upon mount Sinai on the third day visible to all the people
